description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Sets the speech model voice for this business's phone line (inbound and every place_phone_call), until changed again. Default is Aoede. Pass a Gemini prebuilt voice name (letters only, e.g. "Aoede", "Puck"); pass an empty string to reset to the default. place_phone_call cannot pick a different voice per call — set it here or read phone.call_voice in receptionist_service. Tone and language on a specific outbound call belong in place_phone_call's purpose; the inbound opening line belongs in front_desk greeting (update_front_desk).
name: receptionist_call_voice
title: Set phone call voice
